name: rosetta-partial-function-application
code:
use default

fs(f: (int) -> int, s: Iterable[int]) -> Pipe[int] =>
    s |> map(f)

f1(n: int) -> int => n * 2
f2(n: int) -> int => n * n

let fsf1 = s => fs(f1, s)
let fsf2 = s => fs(f2, s)

for s in [0::3, [2, 4, 6, 8]] do
    write_line("fsf1: {fsf1(s) |> join(", ")}")
    write_line("fsf2: {fsf2(s) |> join(", ")}")
od
